title: Wireless Pentesting
description: Build evidence-first wireless assessment skills: scope, understand the protocol, investigate, validate conclusions and plan a safe next test.
longDescription: Work through seven assessment phases, from wireless foundations to Enterprise trust and network boundaries. Start with the Aster foundations case: reconstruct observations, challenge assumptions and justify your next decision. Practice uses synthetic evidence and self-review; live AP/client execution and independently graded field competence are not supplied.

phases.desc: Legacy, Personal, WPS and modern security decisions

phases.name: Wireless Attack Scenarios
phases.desc: Management frames, client trust and guest boundaries

phases.name: Integrated Assessment
phases.desc: Scope, independent evidence and professional conclusions

tagline: Understand the Protocol. Test the Implementation.

title: Web Application Security
description: Hands-on web app pentesting — from recon to exploitation, evidence, and remediation.
longDescription: Planned learning path: Web fundamentals, HTTP, authentication, authorization, input validation, XSS, SQLi, SSRF, file upload, business logic, API discovery, evidence, reporting, retest. Architecture ready, content coming after Wireless path maturity.

title: API Security
description: Hands-on API security testing — OWASP API Top 10, auth, rate limiting, evidence.
longDescription: Planned learning path: API recon, authentication, authorization (BOLA, BFLA), input validation, rate limiting, business logic, evidence, reporting. Architecture ready.

title: Android Application Security
description: Android platform architecture, sandbox boundaries, static triage, IPC, network trust, runtime analysis, and multi-step attack scenarios.
longDescription: 12 authored modules and 46 lessons structured across 6 phases. Master Android platform internals, Linux UID sandboxing, SELinux policies, Binder IPC, APK/AAB triage, deep links, storage security, network security configurations, WebView bridges, non-instrumented dynamic observation, Frida/Objection instrumentation, cryptography, reverse engineering, full attack scenarios, and independent penetration testing methodologies. Paired vulnerable and fixed baselines support concrete retest validation. No prebuilt APK, measured dynamic outcome, independently graded test or field-competence certificate is supplied; quizzes and labs are local self-review, not proof of pentest readiness.
